items.title: Hackers Allegedly Claim Breach of Mercedes-Benz USA Legal and Customer Data
items.description: A threat actor known as “zestix” has claimed responsibility for a significant data breach affecting Mercedes-Benz USA (MBUSA), allegedly exfiltrating 18.3 GB of sensitive legal and customer information.
